title: Editing a Root Certificate for Zero Trust Browser in Private Access

blocks.text: After a root certificate is added to your organization, you can edit it at any time, even while it's associated with an isolation profile. The only root certificate you cannot edit is the default Zscaler Root Certificate. To learn more, see About Root Certificates for Zero Trust Browser in Private Access.
You cannot change the PEM file when editing a root certificate. To use a different PEM file, create a new root certificate.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Browser > Browser Isolation Private Apps > Root Certificates.
Click the Edit icon for the certificate.
The Edit Root Certificate drawer opens.
In the Edit Root Certificate drawer, edit the Name for the root certificate.
